identity: expected current canonical public key, not an account selector
namespace: server principal's account + canonical identity, domain-separated SHA-256; caller supplies neither account nor path
persistence: transactionally committed NCJ2; verified originals and exact outgoing bytes only; no plaintext rumors, previews or private drafts
revision: nonnegative current journal revision; index/event/outbox pin it when nonzero; snapshot reads current history; destructive checkpoint/wipe require an exact current revision
operation_id: 64 lowercase hex, chosen before a write; ingestion/outgoing event identities deduplicate exact originals across retry
targets: queue freezes one to eight distinct explicit WSS targets with the exact signed original; other actions use an empty array; a repeated event cannot silently change its original bytes or targets
read_scope: ack and ingestion retain relay/subscription ownership; received fields are untrusted until event verification and current session admission
outbox: page every retained publish, including unresolved originals outside the live history/expiry projection; index reply carries the stable full relay pool so masks remain usable after restart
